name: New Prepaid Standard SIM
_note: SIM-only / pay-as-you-go option - no bundle, agent tops up separately later. Kept distinct from the tiered Prepaid Red packs below (PROD-301/302/303) so the Plan step has a genuine zero-cost baseline choice, matching how prepaid is actually sold.
